name: The X Files Collection
overview: The X-Files (also known as The X-Files: Fight the Future) is a 1998 American science fiction thriller film directed by Rob Bowman. Chris Carter wrote the screenplay. The story is by Carter and Frank Spotnitz. It is the first feature film based on Carter's television series The X-Files that revolves around fictional unsolved cases called the X-Files and the characters solving them. The X-Files has spawned one sequel, a 2008 film entitled The X-Files: I Want to Believe released six years after the series ended.

parts.overview: Mulder and Scully, now taken off the FBI's X Files cases, must find a way to fight the shadowy elements of the government to find out the truth about a conspiracy that might mean the alien colonization of Earth.
parts.title: The X-Files

parts.original_title: The X-Files: I Want to Believe
parts.overview: Mulder and Scully are called back to duty by the FBI when a former priest claims to be receiving psychic visions pertaining to a kidnapped agent.
parts.title: The X-Files: I Want to Believe

parts.original_title: The X-Files: I Want to Believe — Vrach Frankenshteyn
parts.overview: Restoring Chris Carter's original uncompromising vision, this R-rated Director's Cut (The X-Files: I Want to Believe – Vrach Frankenshteyn) plunges deeper into the macabre elements excised from the 2008 theatrical release. Out of the FBI for years, an isolated Fox Mulder and Catholic hospital physician Dana Scully are dragged back into the unexplained when a bizarre abduction occurs.
parts.title: The X-Files: I Want to Believe — Vrach Frankenshteyn
